# YingTu

> > YingTu provides comprehensive guides and tutorials for accessing and using cutting-edge AI tools like Google Gemini, OpenAI ChatGPT, Sora, and Nano Banana Pro, with a focus on regional access solutions and practical implementation.

YingTu specializes in helping users navigate AI platform restrictions, subscription methods, and API integrations across China and other regions. The site offers detailed troubleshooting guides, cost comparisons, and step-by-step tutorials for major AI services including Gemini, ChatGPT Plus, Sora 2, and various AI image/video generation tools.

## Key Topics

- Gemini API access and configuration
- ChatGPT Plus subscription methods
- China VPN and regional access workarounds
- Nano Banana Pro watermark removal
- Sora 2 video generation and API
- AI model comparisons (DeepSeek V4, Claude 4.5, GPT-5.2)
- Google AI Pro student discounts
- Payment methods (Google Pay, Apple Pay, virtual cards)
- API proxy and mirror sites
- OpenAI refund and appeal processes
- Consistent character generation
- AI reasoning modes (Deep Think)
- OpenClaw/Clawdbot setup
- NSFW content policies
- Error troubleshooting and fixes
